facts.fact: Minister Marc Alexandre Doumba said the government intends to accelerate deployment of the universal service to open up rural zones and improve connectivity in the interior.
Minister Doumba announced acceleration of the project to build a high-security national data centre and said he wants state and citizen data stored exclusively on national territory.

facts.fact: Minister Doumba said the government is working to progressively end cash payments for administrative and judicial acts, through generalised Mobile Money and a single public administration portal.
Minister Doumba announced the coming finalisation of a Gabonese Start-up Act offering tax advantages, financing facilities and co-working spaces to young tech entrepreneurs.

GAB.note: Co-working spaces are named only as a planned Start-up Act measure; no hub or park is stated.
